title: Kappa Multiplicity Space Recovers Rho
body_html:
Kappa Multiplicity Space Recovers Rho

Let \(G\) be a connected classical group, a special orthogonal group, or an odd orthogonal group covered by the ordinary supercuspidal datum construction. For a supercuspidal datum \(\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho)\), let \(\kappa=\kappa_\Sigma\) be the positive-depth factor in \(\eta_\Sigma=\rho\otimes\kappa\). Then \[ \rho_0=\operatorname{Hom}_{K_{0+}}(\kappa,\pi_\Sigma) \] is isomorphic to \(\rho\) as a \(G_x^0/G_{x,0+}^0\)-module.
proof_html: Take an irreducible component \(\rho'\) of \(\rho_0\). Kim's input shows that \(\rho'\) is cuspidal, and Frobenius reciprocity gives an attached datum \(\Sigma'=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho')\) with \(\pi_\Sigma\simeq\pi_{\Sigma'}\). Hakim-Murnaghan equivalence then forces \(\rho'\simeq\rho\). The multiplicity is \[ \operatorname{Hom}_K(\rho,\rho_0) =\operatorname{Hom}_K(\eta_\Sigma,\pi_\Sigma) =\operatorname{Hom}_G(\pi_\Sigma,\pi_\Sigma), \] which is one by irreducibility.
